name: Innoshima (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Innoshima city emblem in white: a stylised angular device of two peaks, like mountains.
history: Flag of the former city of Innoshima in Hiroshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-10. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 May 1954.

features.role: Innoshima city emblem — a stylised angular device of two peaks, like mountains
